translate-pages.description: Translates a span of manga pages into Thai — reading order, speaker attribution, roles, the translation itself, and the work's notes. Give it a work and a page range.

proofread-against-source.description: Reads a span of translated pages against the Japanese and reports where the Thai says the wrong thing. It never sees the rendered pages and changes nothing.

page-look.description: Looks at finished pages and reports only how they look. It opens no source and no notes, and changes nothing.
